availability.note: Chery AU Tiggo 9 Super Hybrid page lists two price lines, 'Tiggo 9 Super Hybrid Elite FWD' (pricing id 3771) and 'Ultimate AWD' (3671), with live postcode drive-away; Chery has no separate Build & Price configurator. Chery API /api/dynamic-pricing/car-variant/3771?state=VIC&postcode=3000 returns $58,274 (also 3350)

listPrice.note: CarExpert Elite review (19 Aug 2026): '$52,990 plus on-road costs'; CarExpert Elite launch news (14 Apr 2026) 'priced from $52,990 before on-road costs'; CarsGuide price page $52,990 (Glass's, excl. stamp duty and government charges) for 2026 and 2027. No Chery page states the Elite MSRP. Check against Chery's own VIC drive-away $58,274 (footnote N2: includes RRP, 12 months rego, CTP, DEALER DELIVERY and stamp duty): app drive-away at 52,990 = $56,095.58, gap $2,178; the Ultimate's gap is $2,079, so a near-identical delivery/duty premium replicates across grades. Plain back-out (58274-880)/1.042 = 55,081 round-trips to $58,274 but would include dealer delivery (sources.md rule 4). $3,000 cashback (1 Nov-21 Dec 2026) is a campaign and ignored. Unchanged from held

batteryKwh.note: China Tiggo 9 C-DM 106 km trims: 18.7 kWh Gotion LFP (gross/usable not stated). AU spec sheet rounds to '19' (Elite); held value kept. Treated as usable, as on chery-tiggo-8-phev (18.4)

rangeKm.note: China WLTC (WLTP cycle, Chinese homologation) 80 km for the FWD 18.7 kWh pack on 245/50 R20 (AU Elite runs 235/55 R19, so the AU car may do slightly better). No WLTP market takes the FWD car: Chery UK sells only the AWD Summit. AU 90 km is NEDC (ADR 81/02, spec sheet) and higher than WLTC: rejected per direction test. CarExpert Elite review estimates 75-80 km real world in Eco. Held value was 90 (NEDC)

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: batteryKwh / rangeKm x 100 = 18.7/80 = 23.4. AU 156 Wh/km is the NEDC ADR label (not used for a PHEV)

fuelConsumptionL100km.note: No charge-sustaining figure published for the Elite; CarExpert Elite review's 4.6 L/100km hybrid-mode reading is flagged by the reviewer as unreliable. Set below the Ultimate's tested 6.3 (CarExpert) and 7.1 (CarsGuide) because the Elite drops the rear motor and has a lighter pack; matches chery-tiggo-8-phev (6.0) and jaecoo-j7-shs (6.0) on the same 1.5T DHT. Held value kept

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: Chery UK 'All seats up: 143 L' (same 7-seat body; measurement basis not stated, below CarExpert's 148 L to the roof so not a to-roof figure). No cargo cover with the third row up; CarExpert's 448 L to the cargo cover is third row folded, not this field. Matches CarsGuide Ultimate review quoting Chery's 143 L

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: CarExpert: '2065L: 2nd and 3rd rows folded, measured to roof' (same figure on Chery UK page). To the roof, not the belt line: no belt-line figure published; reads high against the convention. Electrifying/CarsGuide quote 2,021 L (alternative measure)

seats.note: AU spec sheet 'Number of Seats 7' both grades

towKg.note: AU spec sheet 'Maximum Towing Mass - Braked Trailer 1500' both grades (unbraked 750, towball 75)

warrantyYears.note: '7-Year Unlimited KM Warranty'; some usage types limited to 7yr/150,000km; no dealer-servicing condition stated. HV battery 8 yr/unlimited km

insuranceAnnual.note: held value kept; sits between chery-tiggo-8-phev-ultimate ($46,990, $1,700) and byd-sealion-8-dynamic-fwd ($56,990, $1,850) and below jaecoo-j8-shs-summit ($59,990, $1,950)

depreciationCurve.note: Chery brand convention used by every chery-* row and the jaecoo/omoda siblings (one curve per brand). Evidence for below-mainstream: $3,000 cashback on both Tiggo 9 grades 1 Nov-21 Dec 2026 plus free-servicing offer (Chery model page), Elite launched $7,000 under the Ultimate six months after it, no resale history

isFuelEfficientForLct.note: AU spec sheet 'Fuel Consumption - Combined (NEDC, ADR 81/02)' 1.5 L/100km <= 3.5

isGreenForVicDuty.note: SRO green passenger car: combined tailpipe CO2 <= 120 g/km; AU spec sheet CO2 combined 35 g/km
